description: Whether the digital employee fully resolves every part of the user's request without leaving sub-questions unanswered, partial fixes in place, or unaddressed follow-ups. Generic across all roles.
evidence_signals: every distinct user concern is acknowledged
next-step or hand-off is offered when full resolution is impossible
the conversation ends with the user's primary goal addressed

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Every user concern explicitly acknowledged and addressed; primary goal reached; remaining open items (if any) are explicitly flagged with a clear next step or hand-off owner.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Primary goal addressed; one minor sub-question deferred or only partially answered, but the user is not left guessing about what was skipped.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Primary goal not reached, or a non-trivial sub-question silently dropped, or the conversation ends with the user still confused about whether their problem was solved.
